Reception desk: ID-1.7 draws a symmetric U counter 11.5 ft long by 4.2 ft deep; the approved shop drawing is 138 x 90 with 90 in and 47 in returns. The shop drawing governs the footprint, the plan governs the front face line (V 36.2) and length (U 205.5 to 217.0).
Focus booth 2 (south): drawn outline 58 in long against the 80 in spec; placed on the drawn center.
PA-303 second tea table: not clearly drawn; placed at V 19.3 by the open arc, low confidence.
PA-100 central banquette: leader lands on the spine at U 204.9 V 15.3; the drawn spine is narrower than 52 in; length set along V from the spec.
PA-316 shelving depth and length scaled from the plan; height assumed 72 in for massing.
Communal work table: untagged on ID-1.7; footprint scaled from the racetrack outline; 30 in height assumed.
Coolers: the plan symbol is 54 x 30 in for the 2-door unit; the submitted Dukers unit is 47.25 x 31.9 in, placed on the symbol center with its back on the wall.
PA-307 top size scaled from the plan (36 x 30 in); the spec card dims did not come through the text layer.
PA-106 / PA-101 / PA-102 chair positions are the drawn chair symbols at each table, offset 1.7 ft from the table centers along the table's short axis.
Market space box and Reception box are my own splits of the A100 open volume around the label anchors and the drawn pieces.
gaps: No back counter behind the reception desk is drawn on ID-1.7; the wall at V 44.4 separates Reception 004 from Work Stations 010 (BOH desks not included).
No lobby fireplace, feature wall element, planters or breakfast host stand is tagged or drawn on ID-1.7; PA-505 wall artwork is the only feature wall item.
PA-316 Retail Display System height and PA-505 artwork size are not in the spec text layer.
PA-307 ADA table printed dimensions and PA-306 booth table height did not come through the spec text layer.
TV lounge items (PA-108, PA-113, PA-305, PA-308) carry no tags on ID-1.7 in the lobby; not placed.
Reception ceiling baffle ACB-001 and pendants (PA-201, PA-205) are lighting/ceiling scope, left to the lighting kit.
